_comment_top: spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1 task 009 (FR-P0-07 write half) — seed row for the dataverse.update_record WRITE tool. GA-MCP-contract-frozen per ADR-039: sprk_toolid local segment equals the GA Dataverse MCP tool name 'update_record'; arguments are 'tablename' + 'recordId' + 'item' exactly as GA (research note notes/audit-inputs/research-dataverse-mcp-2026-07.md; Learn ms.date 2026-06-05; argument shapes captured from the live GA MCP tool schemas 2026-07-05).
_comment_routing: Runtime invocation routes to DataverseUpdateRecordHandler via sprk_handlerclass. Auto-discovered (ADR-010). P2 loop projects the LLM-facing function name from sprk_toolid; sprk_name keeps the SYS- display convention required by the seed script's safety filter.
_comment_obo: spec MUST rule (task-012 audit): the update executes through IDataverseUserClient under the calling user's OBO token. A privilege-denied update fails with the USER's own access error — never escalated via app identity. A table invisible to the user 404s at metadata resolution BEFORE any write.
_comment_side_effect: sprk_sideeffectclass = 100000001 (Write) — SIDE-EFFECT tool. The P2 confirmation gate (FR-P2-02, task 031) suspends/resumes this tool BY THIS DECLARED CLASS (never by tool-name list); the handler itself contains NO gating logic. Lands dark at P0.
_comment_update_only: Update-only semantics: the handler PATCHes with If-Match: * so a missing/invisible record yields the user's own 404 instead of the Web API's default upsert-create (an update must never masquerade as a create).
_comment_consumption: Read by scripts/Seed-TypedHandlers.ps1. Idempotent — UPSERT by sprk_handlerclass + sprk_toolcode with sprk_name 'SYS-%' filter.
sprk_description: Updates columns on one existing Dataverse record under the calling user's permissions. Call dataverse.describe first if the table's schema is unknown — do NOT guess column logical names from display names. Only the columns present in 'item' are changed. Values: strings/numbers/booleans for simple fields; numeric option values for choice columns; comma-separated numeric values for multi-select choice; lookup fields as {"relatedTable": "...", "recordId": "guid"}. Update-only: a record that does not exist or is not visible to the user fails with not-found — it is never created. WRITE tool: executes with the user's own privileges. Spaarke entity map: 'matter' = sprk_matter (name column sprk_mattername), 'project' = sprk_project (sprk_projectname), 'document' = sprk_document (sprk_documentname); people = contact, companies = account.
_comment_availableincontexts: 100000001 = Chat only — dataverse.* tools exist for the agent loop (P2), not playbook nodes.

sprk_jsonschema.title: dataverse.update_record Request
sprk_jsonschema.description: Argument shape frozen against the GA Dataverse MCP update_record(tablename, recordId, item) tool.

tablename.description: The logical (schema) name of the table to update a record in (e.g. 'account', 'sprk_event').

recordId.description: The GUID of the record to update.

item.description: Properties to update as key-value pairs. Keys are column logical names from dataverse.describe. Values: strings, numbers, or booleans for simple fields. For lookup/customer fields use an object: {"relatedTable": "account", "name": "Contoso Ltd", "recordId": "guid"} (recordId required on this transport). For choice fields use the numeric option value. For multi-select choice use comma-separated values like "100000002,100000004".

tablename.description: Table logical name of the updated record.

columnsUpdated.description: Column logical names updated (identifiers only — never values).

sprk_configuration._comment: No method-discriminator dispatch — single LLM-facing function. Reserved for per-environment defaults.
